name: io.github.BetaNYC/nyc-311-mcp
title: NYC 311
description: NYC 311: how to report a problem, district numbers from BoardStat, the 311 calendar and alerts

environmentVariables.name: NYC_311_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Free NYC 311 Public API key for the calendar, status, request lookup and reporting tools. The district tools work without it

environmentVariables.name: SOCRATA_APP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional NYC Open Data app token, used by the call center report

environmentVariables.name: NYC_311_MCP_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder for the data cache (about 85 MB of public City data). Defaults to the system cache folder
